title: August Net GMV
description: Synthetic demo; paid_at in Asia/Shanghai, [2026-08-01, 2026-09-01). Actual outcome is determined by runtime validation.
question: August Net GMV

runtime_request.candidate_sql: WITH gross_total AS (SELECT SUM(i.quantity * i.unit_price - i.discount_amount) AS gross FROM orders o JOIN order_items i ON o.order_id = i.order_id WHERE o.order_status IN ('paid', 'completed') AND o.paid_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-08-01' AND o.paid_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-09-01'), refund_total AS (SELECT SUM(r.refund_amount) AS refund FROM orders o JOIN refunds r ON o.order_id = r.order_id WHERE o.order_status IN ('paid', 'completed') AND o.paid_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-08-01' AND o.paid_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-09-01' AND r.refund_status = 'approved') SELECT g.gross - r.refund AS net_gmv FROM gross_total g CROSS JOIN refund_total r
